english.title: Conspire to make / possess / control apparatus / article / material designed / adapted to make false identity documents
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) with the intention that you or another would make a false identity document and that the document would be used by somebody for establishing, ascertaining or verifying personal information, conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to have in your possession or under your control

(E)_[apparatus, namely **(..SPECIFY THE APPARATUS..), which to your knowledge was or had been specially designed or adapted for]_
(F)_[an article or material, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ARTICLE OR MATERIAL..) which to your knowledge was or had been specially designed or adapted to be used in]_

the making of false identity documents
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
